markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged tier-1 frozen section with single-class conformal set, model agreement, and clear margins (≤23% risk) [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%, Benign/InSitu/Invasive 0% [F1] | Zero invasive risk; 5% test ECE |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (alpha 10%; 90% coverage) | Separated at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 66% OOD (12/12 regions) [F6] | Passes QC despite stain-3 degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (89%–91% similarity) [F5] | Unanimous neighbors; InSitu contrast 80% |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 1, 4, 7) · context · High score (z=1.47); descriptive only (8/20 AI spot-check) [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 3, 8) · ↓ invasive · Top anti-invasive score (-0.94) [F3], unreliable (0/20 spot-check) · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score (z=-1.04) slightly favors invasion (+0.46; 12/20 spot-check) [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Low score (contribution -0.34) opposes invasion (19/20 spot-check) · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 9) · ↓ invasive · High score (z=1.11, -0.26) opposes invasion (20/20 spot-check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (top-3 deletion +0.0114, CI +0.0021 to +0.0197); all 12 regions score 0.0.
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion +0.0008, CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); uses unreliable normal lobules (0/20 spot-check).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 frozen-section stain degradation masks subtle *in situ* disease like contrast case `BACH_0117` (InSitu, 80% similarity).
- Focal atypia is missed with HoVer-Net cell segmentation disabled and 70% reliability AUROC (132-case, 24-patient test set).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 8**: Verify normal two-layered lobules directly; concept is unreliable (0/20 AI spot-check).
2. **Regions 4, 7, 10**: Inspect dense lymphocytes and exclude masked ductal or stromal nuclear atypia.
3. **Regions 0, 8**: Confirm clear superior and medial margins where segment probabilities reach 23% and 12%.
